item.title: API Testing Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics & Concepts)

  1. Explain API?
  2. What is an API?
  3. What are the different types of API?
  4. What is the full form of J-SON?
  5. Explain CRUD operations?
  6. What are the main components of an HTTP request and response?
  7. What are common status codes you get in API testing?
  8. What is the difference between POST and PUT?
  9. What is the difference between PUT and PATCH?
  10. What is the difference between GET and POST?
  11. What is the difference between synchronous and asynchronous API calls?
  12. Explain idempotency in APIs? Why is it important?
  13. What is API versioning and why is it needed?
  14. What are query parameters and path parameters?

Intermediate (Tools & Methods)

  1. What tools have you used for API testing (Manual & Automation)?
  2. How do you use Postman for API testing?
  3. Explain Postman tool extensions?
  4. How do you use authentication in Postman?
  5. How do you use collections in Postman?
  6. How do you use environments and variables in Postman?
  7. Explain the concept of Rest Assured?
  8. What are all the methods in Rest Assured?
  9. What are the dependencies needed for Rest Assured?
  10. What is chaining in Rest Assured?
  11. How do you validate the status code in Rest Assured?
  12. How do you validate the response body in Rest Assured?
  13. Explain .given(), .when(), and .then() in Rest Assured?
  14. How do you handle JSON response validation?
  15. What is mocking in API testing and what tools do you use?
  16. What is contract testing and why is it important?

Advanced (Scenarios & Architecture)

  1. How do you approach testing RESTful APIs from scratch?
  2. How do you cover end-to-end API testing?
  3. How do you handle API testing when dependent services are down?
  4. What is SQL Injection in API security testing?
  5. Explain concurrency testing in APIs?
  6. If an API returns a 500 error, how would you troubleshoot it?
  7. How do you test backward compatibility of an API?
  8. Describe a challenging API testing issue you have faced and how you resolved it?
  9. How do you integrate API tests into a CI/CD pipeline?
  10. How do you validate response data integrity against a database?
  11. How do you perform performance testing for APIs?
  12. Write a code snippet for a POST request in Rest Assured?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Basics & Concepts) - Answers

1. Explain API?

Answer: API stands for Application Programming Interface. It acts as a bridge that allows two software applications to communicate and share data with each other.
